assertions.name: block_contributions_are_sqrt_u_order
assertions.source: Per-block Δtr_M contributions are O(ε)=O(√u); the ladder c_3 is O(u³)=O(ε⁶); the shared value -2 is an accidental cross-order coincidence (symbolic ε-series, exact).

description: Order audit of the H_3(q) per-Wedderburn-block Δtr_M contributions vs the Q_β ladder variable u = b·ℏ². Shows the per-block forms are O(√u) (ε¹ coefficients -2/-1/-2) while the ladder c_3 is the u³ (=ε⁶) coefficient — five ε-orders apart (ε¹ vs ε⁶) in two different objects, so the shared value -2 is an accidental coincidence, not a structural identity. This is the root cause of the four-session c_3 wire/un-wire flip-flop. Includes the q₀-independence diagnostic (per-block ε-coefficients are fixed rationals, anchor-invariant) locating the empirical c_3 swing entirely in the (open) categorical map f. Proposes no fitted form. Sub-attack of probe-qbeta-habiro-element-search.

accidental_coincidence_finding.verdict: The per-block -2 (order √u) and the ladder c_3 = -2 (order u³) are five ε-orders apart (ε¹ vs ε⁶) in two different objects; the shared value is a numerical coincidence, not a structural identity. Root cause of the four-session c_3 wire/un-wire flip-flop.

q0_independence_diagnostic.conclusion: Per-block ε-coefficients are fixed rationals (identical at both q₀ anchors); the empirical c_3 swing lives entirely in the categorical map f.

open_problem_characterization.open: categorical map f: Δtr_M (order √u) ↦ Q_β ladder (c_3 at order u³); a q-dependent scaling/eigenphase map
open_problem_characterization.not_the_problem: 'which near-match value for c_3' — the value -2 is an accidental ε¹ coincidence
open_problem_characterization.tier: block structure: proved; c_3: near-match; f-map: open
